tools.name: get_memorial
tools.description: Full detail for one public memorial: dates, cemetery, and the history of flower deliveries made to that grave, each with a photo count.

slug.description: Memorial slug, the last path segment of its URL.

tools.name: list_arrangements
tools.description: The flower arrangements BloomBridge can place at a grave, with prices.

tools.name: list_plans
tools.description: Delivery plans and pricing: one-time, or recurring remembrance plans of one to four deliveries a year.

tools.name: prepare_order
tools.description: Build a checkout link that arrives with the plan, arrangement and grave details already filled in, so the customer only has to confirm and pay. Use this once you know what they want. It does NOT place an order or take payment: it returns a URL for a person to open.

plan.description: single, sub1, sub2, sub3 or sub4. Default single.

arrangement.description: Arrangement name, SKU or id from list_arrangements.

tools.name: search_memorials
tools.description: Search public BloomBridge memorial pages by name, or by cemetery. Returns matching people with their dates, cemetery and page URL. Only memorials the family chose to make public are searchable.

name.description: Full or partial name of the person.

tools.name: start_order
tools.description: Returns the URL a person opens to order flowers for a grave. This does NOT place an order or take payment: a human completes checkout in a browser. Give the URL to the person you are helping.
